system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud KMS key ring and a key for encrypting Cloud Storage objects.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud KMS key ring and a key for encrypting Cloud Storage objects.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: kms-keyring
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ env["project"] }}/locations/{{ properties["region"] }}
    keyRingId: {{ properties["keyRingName"] }}

- name: kms-cryptokey
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.kms-keyring.name)
    cryptoKeyId: {{ properties["cryptoKeyName"] }}
    purpose: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
    rotationPeriod: {{ properties["rotationPeriod"] }}
    versionTemplate:
      algorithm: GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION
    labels:
      environment: {{ properties["environment"] }}
      service: cloud-storage

- name: kms-cryptokey-iam
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys.setIamPolicy
  properties:
    resource: $(ref.kms-cryptokey.name)
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
        members:
        - serviceAccount:{{ properties["serviceAccount"] }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - kms-cryptokey
